desired_performances: Given a tabular dataset, transform missing or invalid values and justify the transformation choices.

objectives.performance: Identify missing and invalid values in a tabular dataset using pandas
success_criteria: Correctly identifies null, NaN, and empty string values
Detects invalid values based on expected data types or ranges

assumption_notes: Assumes pandas as the primary tool based on industry standard for Python tabular data

objectives.performance: Select and apply appropriate transformation strategies for missing values
conditions: Considering data distribution and domain context
success_criteria: Applies deletion, imputation, or flagging strategies appropriately

objectives.performance: Justify transformation choices based on data characteristics and analysis goals
conditions: With access to data summary statistics and domain requirements
success_criteria: Explains trade-offs of chosen transformation approach
References data properties that inform the decision

assessments.capability_claim: Transform missing or invalid values in a tabular dataset and justify the transformation choices

required_evidence.criterion: Correctly identifies at least 3 types of data quality issues in the provided dataset
required_evidence.rationale: Demonstrates understanding of common missing and invalid value patterns

required_evidence.criterion: Applies at least 2 different transformation strategies with correct pandas syntax
required_evidence.rationale: Shows procedural capability with the primary tool

required_evidence.criterion: Provides written justification referencing specific data characteristics and analysis context
required_evidence.rationale: Demonstrates metacognitive evaluation of transformation decisions

task.description: Given a CSV file with multiple data quality issues (missing values, type mismatches, outliers), write Python code to identify problems, apply appropriate transformations, and document your reasoning in comments or markdown
conditions: Dataset includes numeric and categorical columns

performance_levels: Identifies 2-3 issue types with partial accuracy
Identifies 3+ issue types with full accuracy
Code has errors or applies inappropriate transformations
Code runs but transformations are partially appropriate
Code runs and all transformations are appropriate and correct
Justification clearly links data properties, transformation choice, and analysis impact

scoring.mastery_rule: Achieves highest performance level on at least 2 dimensions and middle or higher on the third

assumption_notes: 30-minute estimate aligns with 60-minute total constraint allowing time for instruction

assessments.capability_claim: Identify missing and invalid values using pandas methods

task.description: Complete code snippet to detect missing values in a given DataFrame column

prerequisites.capability: Write and execute basic Python scripts
Understand tabular data structure (rows, columns, data types)
prerequisites.rationale: Necessary to work with datasets but not explicitly confirmed in brief
Required for pandas-based data processing but not confirmed in learner state

sequencing_rationale: Module 1 establishes identification skills before transformation
Module 2 builds on detection to teach transformation and justification together
Module 3 provides summative assessment with time buffer

lessons.lesson_goal: Use pandas methods to identify missing values in a DataFrame
lessons.expected_learner_activity: Observe demonstration of .isnull(), .isna(), .info(), and .describe() methods on sample dataset with various missing value patterns

lessons.lesson_goal: Detect invalid values using type checking and domain constraints
lessons.expected_learner_activity: Follow along as instructor identifies invalid values (negative ages, out-of-range dates, type mismatches) and explains detection logic

lessons.lesson_goal: Apply deletion, mean/median imputation, and forward-fill strategies using pandas
lessons.expected_learner_activity: Practice applying .dropna(), .fillna() with various parameters on provided datasets with instructor guidance and immediate feedback

lessons.lesson_goal: Evaluate and justify transformation decisions based on data distribution and use case
lessons.expected_learner_activity: Analyze three scenarios with different data characteristics and analysis goals, discuss trade-offs, and select appropriate transformation with written justification

special_review_question: Ignoring machine traceability or schema issues, is this instructional design pedagogically reasonable?
